name: Zoom App Marketplace

sources.title: Zoom Developers — App distribution / Marketplace submission overview

requirements: Only applicable if the product is a genuine Zoom integration/app built in the Zoom developer platform — not a generic listing
All public apps must pass the App Submission Review: phase 1 reviews metadata, usability and compliance; phase 2 is a security audit with a focused security test on Zoom scopes
Published apps must provide Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, self-serve documentation and a Support URL under the Zoom Marketplace Developer Agreement
Ongoing user support obligations apply after publishing
Alternatives exist that skip public listing: Unlisted apps, Beta apps (shareable via authorization URL), Private apps for your own Zoom account
preparation: A built Zoom app in the Marketplace build flow (OAuth credentials, scopes configured, event subscriptions if needed)
A Zoom account with developer access
Hosted support pages: Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, support URL, and user documentation
Listing metadata: app name, descriptions, icon/screenshots, categories, scopes justification
workflow: Create/configure the app at marketplace.zoom.us / developers.zoom.us build flow
Develop and test the app against the 'Before you build' prerequisites
Decide audience: external Zoom users (full Marketplace review) vs users within your Zoom account (no Marketplace review)
Submit the app for App Submission Review and respond to the Marketplace Operations team's compliance feedback
Pass the security audit/security test on scopes
App is published to marketplace.zoom.us and becomes installable by external users
watchFor: Two-phase review means real lead time — metadata/compliance iteration plus a security audit
Only request the Zoom scopes the app truly needs; the security test focuses on scopes
Missing ToS/Privacy/Support URLs block submission — they are agreement requirements, not optional polish
If a public listing is not needed, an Unlisted or Private app avoids the review entirely
countsAsLive: The app appears on marketplace.zoom.us with a public app page and can be installed by external Zoom users
unknowns: Current review cycle time and rejection rates
Any fees for marketplace programs (listing itself documented as part of the developer program)
